items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: Barquet used to play with Freddie Kepler. Used to play with Freddie Kepler lots of time.

ctx.x: I was going to ask about some of the old times there, Nettis, when you first moved to the city. Did you hear people like Big Eye and Piku and... Yeah. Or was McCurdy around? Do you remember him? I heard of him, but I never heard of him play. I heard of McCurdy. I never heard of him play yet. Did you ever hear George Barquet? Was he hearing when you were in the bar?

Yeah, I haven't heard of Barquet. Barquet used to play with Freddie Kepler. Used to play with Freddie Kepler lots of time. I used to go to dancing. George Barquet was playing. I had to sit right up under the music stand, listen to that man play, crying there. Was he good? He was real good. Right. And he played a whole lot of low register. Low register? Plenty of low register. He'd go up and make them notes, you know, go way up and come down, you know, breathe and just scream, you know, and the way up. Make them…
Who was your favorite clarinetist of all of the old time men that you heard when you were a boy? Who did you like best? I liked Johnny Dawson's best. You got to hear Johnny Dawson?
